title: ConnectRejected
description: Server -> client. `connectRequest` refused. A distinct message from `error` because it is an expected outcome of a well-formed request, not a protocol fault.

reason.description: `notPaired` covers unknown, never-paired and revoked alike -- distinguishing them would let a caller enumerate deviceIds. `alreadyInSession` means one of the two devices is already in a live session; a second request never silently displaces a working one.
